```{r}
library(haven)
cdystonia <- read_dta("~/Downloads/cdystonia.dta")
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(irr)

cdystonia <- cdystonia %>%
  mutate(patient_id = interaction(site, id, drop = TRUE))
```

estimates the proportion of variance attributable to differences between patients after accounting for average differences by week
```{r}
# Fit the longitudinal random-intercept model
cd_model <- lmer(
  twstrs ~ factor(week) + (1 | patient_id),
  data = cdystonia,
  REML = TRUE
)

# Calculate the ICC
get_icc <- function(model) {
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))

  between_var <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "patient_id"]
  within_var <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]

  between_var / (between_var + within_var)
}

icc_longitudinal <- get_icc(cd_model)

# Parametric bootstrap for the 95% CI
set.seed(123)

boot_results <- bootMer(
  cd_model,
  FUN = get_icc,
  nsim = 1000,
  type = "parametric",
  use.u = FALSE
)

# Extract the percentile confidence interval
icc_ci <- quantile(
  boot_results$t[, 1],
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

icc_longitudinal
icc_ci
```


```{r}
cd_wide <- cdystonia %>%
  filter(week %in% c(0, 2)) %>%
  select(patient_id, week, twstrs) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = week,
    values_from = twstrs,
    names_prefix = "week_"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(week_0, week_2)

icc_data <- data.frame(
  week_0 = as.numeric(cd_wide$week_0),
  week_2 = as.numeric(cd_wide$week_2)
)

nrow(icc_data)
```


```{r}
icc_consistency <- irr::icc(
  icc_data,
  model = "twoway",
  type = "consistency",
  unit = "single"
)

icc_consistency
```


```{r}
icc_agreement <- irr::icc(
  icc_data,
  model = "twoway",
  type = "agreement",
  unit = "single"
)

icc_agreement
```


```{r}
# Average-measure consistency ICC
icc_consistency_avg <- irr::icc(
  icc_data,
  model = "twoway",
  type = "consistency",
  unit = "average"
)

icc_consistency_avg

# Average-measure absolute-agreement ICC
icc_agreement_avg <- irr::icc(
  icc_data,
  model = "twoway",
  type = "agreement",
  unit = "average"
)

icc_agreement_avg
```

```{r}
cd_all <- cdystonia %>%
  select(patient_id, week, twstrs) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = week,
    values_from = twstrs,
    names_prefix = "week_"
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

icc_all_visits <- cd_all %>%
  select(starts_with("week_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

irr::icc(
  icc_all_visits,
  model = "twoway",
  type = "agreement",
  unit = "average"
)
```

```{r}
cd_all <- cdystonia %>%
  select(patient_id, week, twstrs) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = week,
    values_from = twstrs,
    names_prefix = "week_"
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

icc_all_visits <- cd_all %>%
  select(starts_with("week_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
icc_all_results <- irr::icc(
  icc_all_visits,
  model = "twoway",
  type = "agreement",
  unit = "average",
  conf.level = 0.95
)
```


```{r}
results <- data.frame(
  ICC_type = c(
    "Longitudinal variance-components",
    "Consistency: single",
    "Absolute agreement: single",
    "Consistency: average (2 visits)",
    "Absolute agreement: average (2 visits)",
    "Absolute agreement: average (6 visits)"
  ),
  ICC_value = c(
    icc_longitudinal,
    icc_consistency$value,
    icc_agreement$value,
    icc_consistency_avg$value,
    icc_agreement_avg$value,
    icc_all_results$value
  ),
  CI_lower = c(
  icc_ci[1],
  icc_consistency$lbound,
  icc_agreement$lbound,
  icc_consistency_avg$lbound,
  icc_agreement_avg$lbound,
  icc_all_results$lbound
),

CI_upper = c(
  icc_ci[2],
  icc_consistency$ubound,
  icc_agreement$ubound,
  icc_consistency_avg$ubound,
  icc_agreement_avg$ubound,
  icc_all_results$ubound
)
)

print(results, digits = 4)
```
